customer_name: Shenzhen Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Society (AIRS)
business_problem: AIRS needed more integrated compute, data, and model tooling to push embodied-intelligence research from isolated technical advances into a broader ecosystem that could support open systems, company collaboration, and practical industry landing.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud supports AIRS with AI Infra, heterogeneous compute scheduling, and HPC services so the institute can connect embodied-model research with open platforms, datasets, and deployable systems. AIRS is tackling the three core midstream problems in embodied intelligence: algorithms, compute, and data. To address them, the institute has released the AIRSHIP open embodied-intelligence systems, the AIRSTONE embodied compute platform, and the AIRSPEED open data platform, while also advancing the next generation of embodied foundation models such as OmniRL. Baidu's role is to supply the flexible GPU compute, high-performance storage, CPU/GPU mixed scheduling, and elastic training environment needed to build and evaluate those models and platforms efficiently in the cloud. This lets AIRS move from algorithm research into practical infrastructure for robot perception, motion planning, multimodal training, and startup incubation, creating a full 'model-data-compute-platform' loop for embodied AI rather than treating each layer separately.

solution_components.name: AI Infra Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud compute, storage, and scheduling base AIRS uses for embodied-model training, inference, and experimentation.

solution_components.name: AIRSHIP
solution_components.role: Acts as an open embodied-intelligence systems base that AIRS positions as an Android-like platform for robots and autonomous systems.

solution_components.name: AIRSTONE
solution_components.role: Supplies the embodied-intelligence compute platform designed for deployable, evolvable edge-side embodied systems.

solution_components.name: AIRSPEED
solution_components.role: Provides automated multimodal data generation and labeling for model training, evaluation, and iteration.

data_flow: Embodied-model training jobs run on Baidu's AI Infra and HPC environment, AIRSPEED generates and labels multimodal data, AIRSHIP and OmniRL consume the resulting models for service robots, industrial robots, and autonomous driving experiments, and AIRSTONE supplies deployable compute for embodied systems at the edge.
business_outcome: AIRS accelerated embodied-AI research and ecosystem development, giving the institute a stronger path from core research into enterprise collaboration, startup incubation, and deployable intelligent systems.
architecture_clues: The solution explicitly organizes embodied AI around the four layers of model, data, compute, and platform.
CPU/GPU mixed scheduling and high-performance parallel file storage are core parts of the runtime design.
The same stack supports open research systems, startup incubation, and enterprise evaluation workflows.
evidence_quotes: AIRS relies on Baidu AI Cloud's AI Infra platform, heterogeneous compute scheduling, and high-performance computing to accelerate the development of a general meta-learning agent and build a full 'model-data-compute-platform' ecosystem. (original: AIRS依托百度智能云的AI Infra平台、异构算力调度及高性能计算能力，加速“通用元学习智能体”研发，推动AIRSHIP、AIRSTONE等开源系统落地，构建具身智能“模型—数据—算力—平台”全链条生态。)

AIRS has already released AIRSHIP, AIRSTONE, and AIRSPEED to tackle the algorithm, compute, and data challenges of embodied intelligence. (original: 2024年底，AIRS已发布AIRSHIP、AIRSTONE、AIRSPEED三套开源系统以及下一代具身智能基础模型，帮助具身智能行业应对三大核心挑战。)

AIRSPEED can automatically generate and label high-quality reproducible multimodal data and has already supported companies in model training, evaluation, and product iteration. (original: AIRS打造的AIRSPEED具身智能开源数据平台，实现了高质量、可复现、多模态的数据自动生成与标注，已支撑数家企业完成模型训练、能力评测与产品迭代。)

Baidu's HPC platform gives AIRS one-stop high-performance compute and storage, including GPU compute, high-performance storage, and CPU/GPU mixed scheduling. (original: 利用百度智能云GPU算力、高性能存储等基础设施...同时平台可实现 CPU/GPU异构算力混合调度。)
AIRSTONE uses dataflow-driven and chiplet-based design to deliver low-power, real-time compute for embodied systems at the edge. (original: AIRSTONE具身智能计算平台，采用数据流驱动与Chiplet模块化设计，实现低功耗、高实时性的计算能力。)
